confidence.rationale: The official site and its linked Toast catalog independently confirm major catalog and source-authority discrepancies. The packet's exact food-PDF identifier is still current, correcting one Terra assertion without changing the effective outcome.

confirmedFindings: The packet identifies 23 affected baseline items: 5:3-cheese-omelette, 16:beeliner-benny, 17:belgian-waffle, 18:bfast-burrito, 20:blackened-chicken-alfredo, 26:buffalo-chicken-salad, 28:caeser-salad, 33:chicken-and-waffles, 35:chicken-wings, 41:french-toast, 44:from, 46:garden-omelette, 57:lemon-cake, 65:pastrami-reuben, 80:steak-frites, 83:strawberry-french-toast, 91:turkey-club-sandwich, 103:wings-dollar1625-for, 105:breakfast-sandwich, 106:short-rib-hash, 107:steak-and-eggs, 111:bluebeerry-milkshake, and 116:coffee-drinks. Reconciliation covers all 131 baseline rows: 130 normalized_match/mismatch and one artifact/mismatch, with 131 unique reconciled keys.

The official-linked Toast menu exposes nine categories and far more than eight products, confirming catalog collapse and count drift. It includes baseline matches plus omitted current products such as Teriyaki Hash and Loaded Tots.
The official site exposes Food, Drinks, Toast ordering, and Catering menu surfaces. Catering was omitted upstream, and the current drinks PDF identifier differs from the packet's drinks identifier.

No complete restaurant-issued allergen matrix, ingredient disclosure, or cross-contact statement was found. Empty allergen arrays, negative conclusions, and complete-allergen claims are therefore unsupported.
Chicken Wings offers Soy Ginger as one selectable flavor. This does not support may-contain soy or a shared-equipment/cross-contact conclusion.

Narrow positive evidence remains valid where the linked menu explicitly names an allergenic ingredient or unavoidable identity: eggs support egg; cheddar, American, Swiss, mozzarella, provolone, cheese blends, and butter support milk. This preserves valid positives for items including the omelettes, Bfast Burrito, Beeliner Benny, Belgian Waffle, Breakfast Sandwich, Short Rib Hash, Steak and Eggs, and Fried Cheese Curds.
The frozen row 44:from is an extraction artifact, and malformed labels such as wings-dollar1625-for and bluebeerry-milkshake confirm parser-quality problems.
The cross_contact gate is valid only as a warning that upstream cross-contact assertions are unsupported; it does not establish that restaurant cross-contact occurs.
rejectedFindings: Terra's characterization of the packet food PDF as a former or stale link is rejected. The current official Food Menu link resolves to the same 27f6b31f5d51415197c938f8332096d6 identifier, although the redirected file could not be inspected by the review client.

The deterministic inaccessibleSurfaceCount of zero is unreliable because the primary PDFs could not be inspected during adjudication. Likewise, currentProductCount 8 reflects extraction failure rather than the live catalog.

Featured-item repetition on Toast is presentation duplication, not evidence of distinct duplicate products. The duplicate_presentations gate should not treat those UI repetitions as separate catalog entries.

Terra over-promoted several culinary assumptions. Belgian Waffle supports milk through explicitly listed butter, but not wheat or egg from the name alone. Tortilla-wrapped Tex Mex Eggrolls do not establish wheat because tortillas may be corn or wheat. Sourdough, brioche, custard, mayonnaise, waffle, and similar culinary terms cannot by themselves establish complete allergen membership without formulation evidence.

Terra's wheat attribution for Breakfast Sandwich and wheat/egg attribution for Turkey Club are not sufficiently supported by the partial Toast descriptions. Their explicit milk positives remain valid, and Breakfast Sandwich separately retains egg because fried eggs are named.
The absence of an allergen from a Toast description cannot support a negative claim, an allergen-free conclusion, or a complete allergen array.

additionalEvidence.summary: Confirms identity and official navigation to Food, Drinks, Toast ordering, and Catering menus.
Current menu page links All-Day Food and All-Day Drinks; the food link retains the packet identifier while the drinks identifier has changed.
Current Alexandria ordering catalog shows nine categories, substantially more than eight products, explicit partial descriptions, and Soy Ginger as a selectable wing flavor.
Current official Food Menu link uses the same identifier as the packet, correcting Terra's stale-link characterization; redirected PDF contents remained inaccessible.
Current All-Day Drinks link has a different identifier from the packet's drinks PDF.
Official Catering Menu surface omitted from the upstream surface inventory; contents could not be independently enumerated.

summary: The packet's effective outcome is sustained. The live official-linked catalog and omitted menu surfaces establish material scope and extraction discrepancies, while the available descriptions support only narrow positive ingredient evidence—not negatives, complete allergen arrays, or cross-contact conclusions. Terra's stale-food-PDF assertion and several culinary allergen inferences are rejected without erasing valid explicit milk and egg positives.
